item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi mdel kha gsang ba'i tan tra phyi mdos bskongs ba'i cha lags byang btsan gyi sha ru mdos
item.coloph: brag dmar btsan gyi bskang (skong) chung / phyi rabs kyis (kyi) don du bla chen po dran pa nam mkha' yis/ sdang (stong) dmu tsha gyer med la gdams pa'o/ gsang ba'i brag la u tra sig phyi rabs las ldan skyes bu la/ bka' rgyud bon gyi dngos grub bab/ sngags kyi bstan pa srung ba'i phyir/ mdos bzhi cha lag gzhung dang bcas / las skal ldan pas spyod yul lo/ bstan pas (pa'i) dar so rgyas par shog
